devdoc.details: Registry for ERC-3643 identities with validation against trusted issuers

params.claimTopicsRegistry: Address of the claim topics registry
params.trustedIssuersRegistry: Address of the trusted issuers registry

deleteIdentity(address).details: Removes an identity from the registry

returns._0: Address of the claim topics registry

getIdentity(address).details: Gets the identity of an investor

returns._0: Address of the trusted issuers registry

investorCountry(address).details: Gets the country code of an investor

isAgent(address).details: Checks if an address is an agent

returns._0: True if the address is an agent

isVerified(address).details: Checks if an identity is verified against the trusted issuers

returns._0: True if the identity is verified

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

registerIdentity(address,address,uint16).details: Registers an identity for an investor

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.claimTopicsRegistry: Address of the claim topics registry

params.trustedIssuersRegistry: Address of the trusted issuers registry

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateCountry(address,uint16).details: Updates the country code of an investor
